data.proof:
by
  intro ⟨f, hf⟩
  apply hf
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, hs, h2, hm⟩
    refine ⟨?_, hs, h2, hm⟩
    intro n hn
    have h12 : 2 = f 1 * 2 := by
      simpa only [one_mul, h2] using hm 1 2 (by omega) (by omega) (by norm_num)
    have h1 : 0 < f 1 := by omega
    by_cases heq : n = 1
    · simpa [heq] using h1
    · have hlt : f 1 < f n := hs (by simp) (by simpa only [Set.mem_Ici] using (show 1 ≤ n by omega)) (by omega)
      omega
  · rintro ⟨_, hs, h2, hm⟩
    exact ⟨by intro n; omega, hs, h2, hm⟩
